notes.title: v1.1.
STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS, EXIT FROM EARLY ACCESS AND V 1.0.
RELEASE IN EARLY ACCESS AND DISCOUNT 25%.
notes.content:
There was a release in early access, at the moment there is a 25% discount.

The game is in alpha version, so there is still a lot of work to do, but we are motivated and together with you - we will make a good game!

Tomorrow the first update will be released, in which bugs will be fixed and new exhibits will be added, new loot items will be added and much more.

P.S : In the next updates we will add Steam achievements!

notes.title: РЕЛИЗ 12 HOURS 2 В РАННИЙ ДОСТУП СО СКИДКОЙ 25%!
notes.content:
Today will be the release of the game in the early access STEAM with 25% discount, which means that you will be able to try out the game at an early stage of development and to participate in its development!

On the day of release, we will release a hot fix update, and fix the most obvious bugs that players will point out to us. The day after the release, the first update of the game will be released!

We plan to release updates approximately once a week.

Regards, SECOND REALITY Team!
